title: Direct, Goal-Oriented Command Dispatch
characteristics: Begins with immediate operational context ('All env variables are loaded', 'Now i have changed the model...').
Clearly enumerates goals (often using numbered lists: 1, 2, 3).
Specifies exact functional deliverables while granting the agent freedom in technical execution within established rules.
Uses assertive, unambiguous directives ('I want you to...', 'ensure not to use...', 'I approved update and edit...').
user_patterns: Context Setting -> Specific Goals -> Hard Constraints -> Tool Recommendations -> Approval Demands
emulator_guideline: When processing commands from the user, immediately parse explicit numbered constraints, identify the underlying objective, and formulate a structured plan before taking action.
